context:
Goal: a local session creates sessions without asking you, as a cloud session does.
Problem (goal): you said you get asked to create sessions locally and not in the cloud (your ruling 20:28). The lane needs the exact words of that prompt, and which tool it names, to find the setting that asks. The prompt lives on your screen, in no log triage can read.
Based on (read): your ruling 20:28 CST via the consultant; the lane is reading the Mac session's logs meanwhile (the consultant's word; unchecked by triage).
Departs from: main — main's local settings leave session creation to an ask; the lane changes that to match cloud.
Meanwhile: the lane reads the Mac session's logs; nothing else waits on this.
lastAnswer: 796: withdrawn by the consultant at 20:32 CST Nov 13, before you answered.

options.gain: The lane finds the exact setting that asks and removes it.
options.label: Done: I pasted the prompt text or a screenshot link in the note box
options.lose: A minute on your Mac or Windows machine the next time the prompt shows.

options.label: I can't show it now
options.lose: The lane relies on the logs only and may miss the setting.

reply: Withdrawn, nothing for you to do. The lane finds the prompt itself by diffing the cloud and local settings and reading the Mac session's logs. It asks you again only if that read fails, and then names the check it ran.
short: Paste the prompt a local session shows before it creates a session
title: When a local session asks you before it creates a session, what does the prompt say? Paste the text or a screenshot
why: Only you see that prompt; the lane that gives local sessions cloud's autonomy needs its exact text to know which setting asks.
